settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.faq_1_answer:
Yes, Canada-wide, with every plant packed in protective materials. We do not ship to P.O. boxes.

Shipping is a flat rate by province and the exact amount shows at checkout. Standard shipping is free from $200 in Ontario, $225 in Quebec, $250 in Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba and Atlantic Canada, and $275 in British Columbia. There is no free shipping to the territories. Express shipping is always extra, even on orders that qualify for free standard shipping.

Free local pickup is available in Brampton, Ontario.
settings.faq_2_answer:
Orders ship Monday to Wednesday only, so plants never sit in a depot over a weekend. Handling is usually 1–3 business days, and an order placed after Wednesday goes out the following week.

Transit is typically 1–5 business days depending on your province and the shipping speed you choose, so allow 2–8 business days from order to door. Live-arrival coverage applies to transit of 5 business days or less, so if standard shipping to your address normally takes longer than that, please choose express. Full details are in our Shipping Policy.
settings.faq_3_question: Do you ship plants during cold weather?
settings.faq_3_answer: Yes. During colder months, insulation and heat packs may be used when necessary to help protect plants during transit. However, extreme weather and shipping delays are outside of our control.
settings.faq_4_question: What happens if my plant arrives damaged?
settings.faq_4_answer:
If your plant arrives dead or severely damaged, contact us within 24 hours of delivery with clear photos of the plant, the packaging, and the shipping label. We will review it and put it right.

If your plant arrives fine but does not pull through over the following weeks, that is covered by our 30-Day Plant Guarantee instead — free replacement within 30 days on plants under $200, and at 50% on plants $200 and over.

Either way, photograph your plant the day it arrives. That photo is required for both routes.
settings.faq_5_question: Do you accept returns or refunds?
settings.faq_5_answer:
Because plants are live and perishable, we do not take general returns or change-of-mind refunds.

What we do instead is replace plants that do not make it. Our 30-Day Plant Guarantee covers every plant for 30 days from delivery, as long as you photographed it on arrival and followed the Acclimation Guide. Full details are in our Refund Policy.
settings.faq_6_question: Will my plant look exactly like the product photos?
settings.faq_6_answer: Each plant is unique. Size, shape, leaf count, and variegation may vary naturally from plant to plant. Product photos are representative examples.
settings.faq_7_answer: Most plants are rooted and acclimated unless otherwise stated in the product description.
settings.faq_8_answer: Tissue culture acclimated plants were originally propagated in sterile lab conditions and then transitioned into regular growing conditions. These plants are carefully acclimated before being sold.
settings.faq_9_question: Can shipping stress affect my plant?
settings.faq_9_answer: Yes. Some yellowing, leaf damage, or minor stress can happen during shipping, especially with rare tropical plants. Most plants recover after adjusting to their new environment.
settings.faq_10_question: What should I do after receiving my plant?
settings.faq_10_answer: We recommend unpacking your plant immediately after delivery and allowing it to adjust to your home environment. Avoid direct sunlight or repotting immediately after arrival.
settings.faq_11_answer: Variegation is natural and may change over time depending on genetics and growing conditions. Future variegation patterns cannot be guaranteed unless specifically stated.
settings.faq_12_answer: All plants are inspected before shipping. However, we still recommend quarantining new plants for a short period after arrival as a precaution.
settings.faq_13_answer: Yes. Local pickup may be available in Brampton, Ontario depending on availability and scheduling.
settings.faq_14_answer:
Yes, within 48 hours of placing the order. Ready-to-ship orders can be cancelled within 48 hours as long as they haven’t shipped; once an order has shipped it can no longer be cancelled. Pre-orders can be cancelled within 48 hours of ordering; after that the order goes to our partner lab and can no longer be cancelled.

Once the 48-hour cancellation window has passed, we may start working on your pre-order right away, even before the batch cut-off. The cut-off is the last day to join a batch, not the day work begins, so your order may arrive earlier than the estimate.

To cancel, email info@agaplantz.com with your order number within the window. Approved cancellations are refunded in full to the original payment method, usually within 5–10 business days.
settings.faq_15_answer:
Pre-orders usually arrive about two to three weeks after the batch cut-off, and sometimes earlier. Once the 48-hour cancellation window has passed, we may start working on your pre-order right away, even before the batch cut-off. The cut-off is the last day to join a batch, not the day work begins, so your order may arrive earlier than the estimate.

When there’s room, we move orders into an earlier shipment so they arrive sooner. The current cut-off date is on our Pre-Order page.
settings.faq_16_question: What if I order ready-to-ship and pre-order plants together?
settings.faq_16_answer:
If you order ready-to-ship and pre-order plants together and we have your pre-order variety in ready-to-ship stock, it is automatically switched to the ready-to-ship plant so your order ships sooner.

That plant is already rooted and acclimated, not a sealed plantlet. If you would rather wait for the plantlet, reply to your order email and we will keep it as a pre-order.
settings.faq_17_answer: We are passionate about rare tropical plants and carefully handle every order with attention and care. Our goal is to provide healthy, beautiful plants for collectors and plant lovers across Canada.
